name: Pirate Raid on the Meridian Run
background: The Meridian Run is the quiet lane between two Union colonies - quiet because a Nelson used to fly it. The escort was pulled for the border, the clans noticed inside a week, and two corsairs and a raider have dropped onto the convoy's transit corridor with their reactors already hot.
victory: Damage levels inflicted (S2.8.4). The freighters are worth their points to whoever kills them - or keeps them alive.
specialRules: The freighters (RUNNER, HORIZON) are civilian hulls: Damage Control 0 - what breaks, stays broken.
Pirates fight for cargo, not glory: a mauled corsair should run (the clans do not reimburse dead captains).

sides.objective: Get the freighters across the table alive; the Nelson buys them the time.
Kill or cripple the freighters and get out before a patrol answers the distress call.
